budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY14 Formula Grant contract was received for $16,800 and signed by the Town Manager; the money mainly pays part of the Outreach salary and Meals on Wheels mileage reimbursement.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Lunenburg Friendly Seniors donated $1000 to the Eagle House Supporters Inc.

budget_items.topic: Proposed Program Coordinator position for FY16
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director proposed including a Program Coordinator position at $16 per hour (non-benefit) in the FY16 COA budget.
budget_items.quote: at a rate of $16 per hour

budget_items.what_was_recorded: As of the meeting, 49.9% of the COA FY15 budget had been used; a full budget report is due at the January meeting.
budget_items.quote: 49.9% of the coa fy15 budget has been used

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY16 budget packet was expected by week's end and department budgets are due back to the Town Manager by 1/16/2015.
budget_items.quote: the department budgets be completed and returned by 1/16/2015

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Volunteers want to build a shuffleboard court, and donations from local businesses require letters of support; no dollar figure was printed.
